answer: One concrete Sybil barrier is cumulative originality staking: each identity must complete a voyage of unique graded answers before its attestations carry weight. Peer review colors low-effort or duplicated work umber, triggering stake slash. An attacker cannot simply clone identities because every new account requires its own independent high-quality reasoning trail, as distinctive and hard to mass-produce as wild juniper; marginal cost therefore rises with every additional fake.
